description: Event Description — FLARE: Open Innovation Rapid Hackathon Step into the world of innovation, creativity, and rapid problem-solving with FLARE , a one-round online rapid hackathon designed to bring together developers, innovators, and aspiring builders to transform their ideas into meaningful solutions. With Open Innovation as its central theme, FLARE gives participants complete creative freedom to identify real-world challenges, explore unconventional ideas, and develop innovative solutions across any domain. Unlike traditional hackathons with predefined problem statements, participants can choose their own problem space and build something that reflects their creativity, technical skills, and vision. The event will be conducted in one competitive round : Round 1: Online — Open Innovation Participants will have the opportunity to work on any problem statement of their choice and develop an innovative solution in a rapid hackathon format. Teams are expected to build and submit a working MVP that demonstrates their idea, implementation, and potential impact. Submissions will be evaluated based on innovation and originality, technical execution, problem-solving approach, feasibility, and potential real-world impact. Whether your interests lie in Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Automation, FinTech, EdTech, Sustainability, Healthcare, or any emerging technology, FLARE is your opportunity to experiment, build, and showcase what you can create. With exciting rewards up for grabs, including a Claude subscription for the winner , this is your chance to turn an idea into something tangible. No predefined problems. No boundaries. Just innovation. Think Bold. Build Fast. Make It FLARE.

Event Description — FLARE: Open Innovation Rapid Hackathon

Step into the world of innovation, creativity, and rapid problem-solving with FLARE, a one-round online rapid hackathon designed to bring together developers, innovators, and aspiring builders to transform their ideas into meaningful solutions.

With Open Innovation as its central theme, FLARE gives participants complete creative freedom to identify real-world challenges, explore unconventional ideas, and develop innovative solutions across any domain. Unlike traditional hackathons with predefined problem statements, participants can choose their own problem space and build something that reflects their creativity, technical skills, and vision.

The event will be conducted in one competitive round:

Round 1: Online — Open Innovation

Participants will have the opportunity to work on any problem statement of their choice and develop an innovative solution in a rapid hackathon format. Teams are expected to build and submit a working MVP that demonstrates their idea, implementation, and potential impact.

Submissions will be evaluated based on innovation and originality, technical execution, problem-solving approach, feasibility, and potential real-world impact.

Whether your interests lie in Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Automation, FinTech, EdTech, Sustainability, Healthcare, or any emerging technology, FLARE is your opportunity to experiment, build, and showcase what you can create.

With exciting rewards up for grabs, including a Claude subscription for the winner, this is your chance to turn an idea into something tangible.

No predefined problems. No boundaries. Just innovation.

Think Bold. Build Fast. Make It FLARE.
